description: A stereo audio player that loads WAV, MP3 and FLAC files and plays the region between two markers.

params.text: Stops playing and leaves the play line where it stands.
Starts playing from the green start marker.
Stops playing and returns the play line to the marker it started from.
Winds the play line forwards through the sample while it is held down.
Winds the play line backwards through the sample while it is held down.
Unloads the file and opens a browser to pick another one.
Sets the output level, 0dB at its default and 6dB at maximum.
Places the sound between the two outputs, full left through centre to full right.
Moves the green marker, where playing begins.
Moves the red marker, where playing ends; put it before the start marker and the sample plays backwards.
Trims the playback rate about a tenth of a step either side of normal, so the sample plays a little slower or faster.
Draws the lower display over the region between the two markers, so a shorter and shorter stretch can be picked out.
Returns the lower display to the wider view it was drawn at before the last zoom.

inputs.text: Moves the panning; 5V drives it fully to one side and -5V fully to the other, added to the knob setting.
Rising past 2V starts playing, and falling back below 0.1V pauses.

outputs.text: The left channel of the player.
The right channel of the player.

notes: nothing plays until an audio file is loaded: press the eject button, or pick Select Audio File from the panel menu, and choose a WAV, FLAC or MP3 file.
the patch stores the path of the loaded file and loads that file again when the patch is opened, so the file has to stay where it was.
the zoom in button does nothing while the start marker is at the beginning of the sample and the end marker is at the end; move one of them in first.
menu: Panningtype — chooses Simple or Constant Power panning; it starts at Constant Power.
PlayMode — chooses Single, which plays the marked stretch once, Repeat, which plays it until it is stopped, or PingPong, which reverses direction at each marker; it starts at Repeat.
Select Audio File — opens a file browser when no file is loaded, and reloads the file named beside it when one is.
